meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把旧版安装平滑升级到新版
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在把旧版迁移到新版
copy.tagline_en: Finish upgrading your old install to the new version
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're moving from an old version to a new one

howto.what: 该技能负责 NanoClaw v1→v2 迁移的收尾:检查迁移报告,修复阻碍机器人收发消息的失败项,确认并设置拥有者,迁移群组历史记忆,核对容器配置,并帮你决定旧版自定义代码的处理方式;最后运行健康检查确认新版正常。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”时触发;它专用于在 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 完成之后接手,如果该脚本还没运行,它会先停下让你运行。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 从 v1 迁到 v2。
say.note: 技能会先检查迁移脚本是否已运行,再继续收尾。

say.text: 迁移完了,帮我看看还需要处理什么。
say.note: 它会读取 handoff 文件,推进后续迁移步骤。

say.text: v1 里我改过的代码怎么处理?
say.note: 它会列出分支,让你选择复制、逐条审查或仅存档。

howto.what_en: Completes v1→v2 migration after the migrate script: reads the report, fixes blockers, seeds the owner, migrates memory, checks container configs, handles custom code, then verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'migrate from v1', 'finish migration', or 'v1 migration'. Intended to run after `bash migrate-v2.sh`; if the script hasn't been run, it stops and asks you to run it first.

say_en.text: Help me migrate NanoClaw from v1 to v2.
say_en.note: It first checks whether the migration script has run, then continues.

say_en.text: The migration is done — what should I handle next?
say_en.note: It reads the handoff file and moves through the remaining steps.

say_en.text: How should I handle the code I changed in v1?
say_en.note: It lists the commits and lets you copy, review, or archive them.
